lines.text: The LORD announces that Babylon is captured and Marduk is shattered, and a nation from the north will make her land desolate.
Israel and Judah will come weeping, ask the way to Zion, and join themselves to the LORD in an everlasting covenant.
The LORD tells His people to flee Babylon because He is bringing great nations from the south against her.
Israel is a scattered flock; the king of Assyria devoured him first, and Nebuchadnezzar king of Persia crushed his bones last.
The LORD will return Israel to graze on Carmel and Bashan, and He will forgive the remnant He preserves.
